resources.string: This works only on this phone. Your note is not sent anywhere.
The AI helper is not set up yet. It needs a one-time download (about 550 MB), best over Wi-Fi.
Please write something in the note first.
What should I do with this note?
For example: “fix the mistakes”, “make it a letter”, “translate into English”, “make a PDF”, “read it to me”.
This AI helper knows only English. For Hindi notes, open AI settings and download the “Gemma 3” helper.
Working on your note… part %1$d of %2$d
This can take a minute on this phone. You can stop at any time; your note will not change.
Please read the new text. The AI helper can make mistakes.
Everything looks fine. Nothing needed to change.
The note was changed. Tap UNDO to get your old text back.
The AI helper is not set up yet. Open Settings and download it first.
This note is too long to make into a letter in one go. Please make the note shorter and try again.
The phone does not have enough free memory right now. Close other apps and try again.
The AI helper could not finish. Your note has not changed. Please try again.
Sorry, I did not understand. Please tap one of the buttons, or try saying it differently.
The AI helper runs fully on this phone. Your notes are never sent anywhere. Only the helper itself is downloaded once; after that it works without internet.
This phone has %1$s GB memory. The AI helper can work here.
This phone has %1$s GB memory. That is not enough for the AI helper. All other features still work.
Needs a phone with more memory
You can keep using the app. If the download stops, it continues from where it stopped.
Checking the file is complete and safe…
This one cannot be downloaded from here. Licence: %1$s
Already have a helper file (ending in .task) from your family? You can add it from the phone.
Add a helper file from the phone
Adding the helper file… please wait.
The AI helper is ready to use.
This file is not a helper file the app knows. Nothing was added.
This download is %1$s and may use a lot of your mobile data. It is better to wait for Wi-Fi.
This frees %1$s. Your notes and documents are not touched. You can download it again later.
No internet connection. Connect to Wi-Fi and try again.
Not enough free space on the phone. Delete some photos or videos and try again.
The download stopped. Tap the button to continue.
The downloaded file was damaged, so it was deleted for safety. Please download again.
Google Play needs your OK before it can download the helper.
This helper comes from Google Play. Install Super Doc from the Play Store to get it, or add the helper file below.
Corrects a short sample sentence and measures how long it takes.
Fast: the helper works well on this phone.
A little slow, but it works. Short notes are best.
Very slow on this phone. Use it only for short notes.
